text: What if your fitness coach lived right on your laptop?
Guessed calorie numbers, and no idea what level you're at.
A fitness AI trained for one job, running privately on your own computer.
You get real exercises with real photos, and you can see every move in motion.
Beginner, intermediate or advanced, every plan matches you.
Never too easy. Never too risky.
Nutrition answers come from real U.S.D.A. data, so there's no guessing.
Every pose is shown by real people, and FitBot builds a full routine for your time, your goal and your level.
and FitBot coaches you with your own steps, heart rate, sleep and stress.
